title: m5stack/CardputerZeroRepository #2 round 3: self-contained iw scan trigger and seat0-first account detection verified at code level

execution.environment: macOS arm64; deb unpacked with ar/tar; AArch64 disassembly with llvm-objdump; no arm64 Linux userland (docker container creation blocked by read-only metadata store)

checks.name: artifact_identity
checks.evidence: 501370 bytes and SHA-256 19a39a46... match the author comment; 7/7 md5sums verify; debian-binary 2.0; evidence/deb-metadata.txt

checks.name: payload_change_scope
checks.evidence: delta vs 67195a6 is the daemon binary, unit Description and postinst seat0 block only; beaconhound-ui byte-identical; evidence/payload-diff-vs-67195a6.txt

checks.name: scan_trigger_argv
checks.evidence: rodata 0x48e1-0x490b builds {iw,dev,<iface>,scan,trigger} and {...,dump}; execv /usr/sbin/iw then /sbin/iw; execvp absent from dynsym; evidence/daemon-iw-fsm.txt

checks.name: capability_justification
checks.evidence: scan trigger maps to NL80211_CMD_TRIGGER_SCAN (GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM), so AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN is required; Debian trixie iw 6.9 has COMMAND(scan, trigger); evidence/iw-trigger-and-exit-codes.txt

checks.name: watchdog_and_reap
checks.evidence: child setpgid(0,0), parent setpgid(pid,pid); 250 ms trigger / 300 ms dump poll deadlines; timeout sends SIGKILL to -pid and pid then waitpid

checks.name: scan_schedule
checks.evidence: next_trigger=now+10000, next_dump=now+1500, dump reschedule +3000; EBUSY retry +2000 with dump clamp +1000

checks.name: error_classification
checks.evidence: EBUSY via 240 or '(-16)'; EPERM/EACCES via 255/243 or '(-1)'/'(-13)' with 1/2/127 excluded -> dump-only latch; other failures 10 s retry with 60 s log throttle

checks.name: freq_parsing
checks.evidence: leading whitespace stripped, strncmp 'freq:' anchor, 2412..2484 filter; per-line 512-byte buffer reset at newline; evidence/daemon-iw-fsm.txt

checks.name: test_hooks_absent
checks.evidence: 0 occurrences of BH_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS in the stripped arm64 ELF

checks.name: postinst_seat0_priority
checks.evidence: detection order: existing instance -> seat0 -> PKEXEC_UID/SUDO_USER -> user@uid -> passwd fallback; postinst 110-188 precedes 190-201; sh -n clean

checks.name: maintainer_scripts
checks.evidence: postinst/prerm/postrm pass sh -n; prerm stops/disables template and legacy units, postrm reloads systemd

checks.name: ci_validation
checks.evidence: validate-submission run 44469413044 conclusion=action_required, 0 s, no jobs; workflow only runs dpkg-deb -I, arch, filename, size

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: Device Service cardputer-zero supported=false creatable=false missing __missing_qemu__/__missing_rom__, separate Linux backend; cannot run a Debian package

checks.name: install_and_execute
checks.evidence: no arm64 Linux userland; docker container creation fails on read-only metadata store

evidence.description: size, SHA-256, ar members, control, md5sums verification, sh -n, ELF headers
payload and control diff against the round-2 artifact
iw argv table, exec paths, watchdog, schedule constants, exit-code classification, freq parser
unit file, postinst detection order, prerm/postrm
iw 6.9 scan trigger command and exit-code semantics
action_required validate run and workflow scope
Device Service cardputer-zero profile and container runtime blocker

notes: Evidence class is code-level verification; the package was not installed and neither binary was executed.
The retained CAP_NET_ADMIN is justified by NL80211_CMD_TRIGGER_SCAN, reversing the round-2 observation that it was unnecessary for dump-only.
iw usage exits 3, not 2; the classifier remains safe because the usage text has no (-1)/(-13) marker.
kismet_handover_active pause/resume could not be tied to an instruction sequence in the stripped binary and stays unverified.
Review comment only; nothing was pushed to the fork or the PR, and the PR was not closed.
